$comment: Single source of truth for the Gemini analysis output shape (plan.md D13, D8, §8.2). The pipeline worker converts this to a Gemini response_schema; the web app's TS types are hand-kept in sync with it. Changing a field here means updating both consumers.

title.description: Human-readable, <=8 words. e.g. 'Mango Yogurt Dessert', not 'Recipe'.

search_context.description: THE primary retrieval signal. 2-4 sentences describing what a person would remember about this post later -- visible content (colors, ingredients, setting, garment type, room, place, on-screen text), not a caption restatement.

keywords.description: 8-15 lowercase terms including synonyms and everyday phrasings not present in the caption.

entities.description: Proper nouns actually visible/named -- brands, restaurants, cities, people, technologies. Empty if none. Never guessed.

ai_metadata.description: Category-specific fields, schema-less by design (CLAUDE.md principle 5). Only fields Gemini is genuinely confident about. Guidance per category: Movies -> title, genre, actors, streaming_platform. Fashion -> clothing_type, color, style, occasion, brand. Beauty -> product_type, brand, skin_concern, technique. Hairstyles -> hairstyle_type, hair_length, technique, tools_used. Food -> cuisine, dish_type, ingredients, meal_type, cooking_time. Travel -> country, city, destination, place_type, activity. Photo poses -> pose_type, setting, subject_count. Tech -> topic, technology, concepts. Fitness -> workout_type, muscle_group, equipment, difficulty. Dance -> dance_style, setting, music_genre. Art -> medium, style, subject. Editing -> software, technique, effect_type. Kids -> activity_type, age_group, occasion. Other -> free-form.
